BrochureContent.Content:
O’Connor Property Management are delighted to bring this spacious three-bedroom, two bathrooms. Situated on the ground floor the apartment to the market.

The property is located in Dunboyne Castle and within walking distance of Dunboyne Village which offers many amenities and services such as schools, shops, restaurants and cafés in addition to various local sporting and recreational clubs and societies. Dunboyne is easily accessible via the M3/N3 and is served by both Irish rail and Dublin Bus with the Blanchardstown Town Centre only a short distance away.

This large bright spacious accommodation measures approximately 108 meters sq .

The Accommodation comprises of:-
Entrance hall 4.94m x 2.98m with (hot press and large walk in storage closet.) Laminated floors.

Living/dining room - 4.90m x 4.61 m
Bright spacious room with feature fireplaced and large picture window. (New Laminated floors throughout) 

Kitchen - 3.09m x 4.62m. Fully fitted kitchen with a range of eye and low-level cream units with a gloss finish, tiled splash, stone counter tops, electric oven & hob and tiled floor. Also plumbed for washing machine and dishwasher. 

Main bedroom - 7.88m x 2.93m. Primary bedroom with en suite 1.89m x 1.74m, built in wardrobes, laminate floor with wc, whb and mains fed shower and tiled floor. (Newly carpeted)

Bedroom two - 4.56m x 2.73m m. Double room with built in wardrobes laminate floor and access to covered patio. (Newly carpeted)

Bedroom three - 4.19m x 2.57m Double room with built in wardrobes, laminate floor and access to covered patio. (Newly carpeted)

Main family bathroom 1.82m x 2.32m Main bathroom with wc, whb, bath with shower head over, tiled floor and window for natural light and ventilation.

Patio – 1.94m x 5.55m
